title: We Tested 10 Years of SPY Strangles Across Every Volatility Regime, Here's What We Found
description:
Options skew, implied volatility regimes, and SPY strangle analysis this Market Measures segment, sponsored by Cboe, explores how P&L distribution shape shifts across different volatility environments. Discover why skew magnitude tends to decline in high IV conditions, how delta selection affects loss exposure, and what historical SPY strangle data from 2015 to 2026 suggests about managing short premium positions. tastylive options research.
